question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The doctors say that the majority of the people who attended the fest are ill due to eating __**adulterated**__ food.
solution: The correct answer is **"contaminated."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Adulterated"** means weakened or lessened in purity by the addition of a foreign or inferior substance or element. (किसी विदेशी या घटिया पदार्थ या तत्व के शामिल होने से शुद्धता कमजोर या कम हो जाती है) • **Example**: *She served me an **adulterated**__ food.* • The synonym of **"adulterated"** is **"contaminated."** • The word **"contaminated"** means something that has been made impure by adding another substance. (कोई ऐसी चीज़ जो किसी अन्य पदार्थ को मिलाकर अशुद्ध कर दी गई हो) __ • **Example**: *That water was **contaminated**__.* • In this context, the doctors are saying that the food was contaminated with harmful substances. • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1: "Spicy"** means having a strong flavor of spices. (मसालेदार, चटपटा) • **Option 2: "Lascivious" **means showing a strong sexual desire. (तीव्र यौन इच्छा दर्शाना) • **Option 4: "Damp"** means slightly wet. (सीलनभरा) 3a:Tc07, The correct answer is **"Dilapidated."**
